basic_info.description: Welcome home to 1408 31st Avenue #305, a bright and airy 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo designed for modern comfort in the heart of the Sunset. This thoughtfully laid-out unit boasts an inviting open concept living area, perfect for both everyday living and hosting guests. The well-appointed kitchen features stainless steel appliances, stone counters, and extensive cabinetry. Retreat to the serene primary bedroom with two large closets with built-ins, along with a private en-suite bathroom, offering a dual vanity and large shower. The second bedroom is equally spacious and is adjacent to the second bathroom, also with dual vanity and lots of storage. Enjoy peaceful outlooks - including views of the Golden Gate Bridge - from multiple rooms! Completing this property are in-unit laundry hookups and dedicated parking. Building features include a ButterflyMX intercom system, large elevator (rare for the Sunset!), and shared outdoor patio. With its central location, 1408 31st Ave provides easy access to the shops and restaurants along Irving Street, public transit, Ocean Beach, and the iconic Golden Gate Park. This is city living at its finest!
